description.content:
This endpoint is not available in Label Studio Community Edition. [Learn more about Label Studio Enterprise](https://humansignal.com/goenterprise)

Retrieve the members for a specific workspace.

query.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to filter by
A page number within the paginated result set.
Number of results to return per page.

header.description:
(Required) The token (or API key) must be passed as a request header. You can find your user token on the User Account page in Label Studio. Example: 
curl https://label-studio-host/api/projects -H "Authorization: Token [your-token]"
